packageRules.description: Only offer module versions that build on the Go line this repo targets (constraints.go below). constraints.go alone just picks the toolchain Renovate runs; without strict filtering it would still propose a dependency whose own go.mod requires a newer Go. This only covers the gomod manager: tools pinned in the Makefile need their own allowedVersions rule (see controller-tools).
Moving the Kubernetes library line (k8s.io/* 0.x, controller-runtime) changes the platforms we support and needs envtest/e2e Kubernetes versions moved with it. Patch updates only.

controller-gen is pinned in the Makefile and read by a custom manager, which the strict Go-constraint filtering above does not cover. v0.22.0 requires Go >= 1.26 and breaks `make manifests` on the repo's Go 1.25. Raise this bound together with the Go line.
The Go version used by CI (setup-go go-version) must follow the go directive in go.mod, the builder image and golangci-lint: raising it is a manual decision.
The docs toolchain's Python version moves together with the pinned mkdocs dependencies, not on its own.

Kubernetes libraries are version-locked to controller-runtime (api, apimachinery, client-go, apiextensions-apiserver move as a set), so keep them in one PR. Their minor line is tied to the platforms we target (OpenShift/OKD 4.21 = Kubernetes 1.34, 4.22 = 1.35, AKS 1.34+; k8s libs 0.35, controller-runtime v0.23): only patch updates are automatic, a minor/major move is a deliberate platform decision.
The go directive in go.mod is a deliberate floor, not something to chase. CI, the builder image and golangci-lint are all pinned to the same Go line; raising it is a manual decision.

Keep the builder image on the Go line the module targets (1.25). golangci-lint cannot parse export data from a newer Go than it was built with, and controller-gen v0.22+ needs Go 1.26, so a silent bump here breaks lint and codegen.

The Riak operand image pins per-architecture bases and full RPM URLs that were chosen by hand (some upstream aarch64 builds SIGILL on non-SVE arm64 — see CLAUDE.md). Version changes here are a curation decision, never an automatic one.
ghcr.io/marthydavid/* images are this repository's own build output. Their tags are set by the release and chart-bump process, not by dependency updates.
Group routine GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR; majors still get their own.
Build and test tooling moves together: it only affects CI and local development, never the shipped operator.
golangci-lint v2 renamed the configuration format, so a major bump needs .golangci.yml migrated by hand in the same PR. Keep it isolated and labelled.
